test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) HDK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/593cd957a5ad663ec47b34f2fb7645b404e6c86ec8f9af5afe6061b2653ab12d.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9433fd74d5d2b7ab64a8401d3a43333739e91db7679325c6fef6f64f745f0736.png] 

Option 2) FBJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/daaaf3745a6745c7d3420ce1e397ca4c0b47c169f30c1f6b0fd9e34727ae35ac.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1caaeacf213aae6c142a50b6f9737f4000f2891f53baa6671fa42f47f024814d.png] 

Option 3) MIP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3677c2ebdb376dca597e3615bdde81ccb9d23e520d7d825dfdba3cc4b860e49.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8513f46e7445b99fc03322f0ccf2cbb4b1989c7fa1906dc50b09f62a9e22040a.png] 

Option 4) JFM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eda2ecb3bf3fe99db3f5b21b1d247748553da61c5011a155c6b7bca06a8f7198.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8fbac02bd27267bdd1557afd30e0b10989409b3499951aeb63145b8cc5ff1ae.png] 

Thus, odd letter-cluster is FBJ.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
